item.tib: dbal chen phur pa yang gsang brnag pa smad las bla med sbyor ba reg chod spu gri 'bar ba'i 'khor lo
item.coloph: ces pa dbal chen phur pa yang gsang brnag pa smad las bla med blo chen gdengs ldan gyi spyod yul 'di yang / grub rig rgyud ldan yongs kyi longs su spyod pa'i gsar rnying rgyud lung las byung ba phyogs gcig tu bsdeb par byas pa yin gyis/ bstan pa spyi la thugs bskyed chen por gnang ba'i skyes chen rnams kyi bka'i bdud rtsi yang yang reg cing / rang dang gzhan gyi rgyud la phan bde 'gyed phyir du kam bla ma tshe dbang bkra shis dang / mchog sprul nyi ma'i dbang po gnyis kyi ched du bskul ba la brten te/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis 'chi med g.yung drung bkod pa'i khang bzang du bgyis shing yi ge'i byed po rig mchog nyi ma'i dbang po dang / tshe dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi bgyis pa'i dge tshogs bstan 'gror smin pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
